name: Substitutive LOD with K-wise Moment-Matched Merging
aliases: Level of Detail (LOD) via Gaussian Merging
definition: A substitutive level-of-detail technique that reduces splat count by merging K splats using moment-matching with L2-optimal amplitude, guided by cost metrics.
summary: Substitutive LOD with K-wise Moment-Matched Merging reduces 3D Gaussian counts by merging groups into single representatives via moment matching, distinguishing itself by operating on final Gaussians using cost metrics rather than density control.
